content.summary: Brenmiller Energy Ltd (NASDAQ:BNRG) shares are trading higher after the company disclosed that it has selected and signed a contractor to lead the implementation and construction phase of its flagship project for Tempo Beverages. Tempo, partially owned by Heineken International B.V., is one of Israel’s largest beverage producers and distributors.
